title: Payload QuickProbe Cards: compact failure cards with inline payload forensics and retry history
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Design a compact, scan-friendly card component (QuickProbe Card) to surface failed requests in the Redwood Console list and enable low-friction forensics: inline error taxonomy badges, localized retry timeline, a one-line payload summary, and an expandable inspector that shows key-value diffs, KV cache hints, and a minimal reproduction run button that opens a safe sandbox. The goal is to reduce mean time to triage (MTT) by providing the most common debugging artifacts in a single compact surface and offering a path to deeper investigation without context switching.
acceptance_criteria: Card renders in list view and collapsed grid without causing layout jank or horizontal scroll
Error taxonomy badges (type, transient vs permanent, retryable) are present and mapped to telemetry fields
Collapsed card shows: timestamp, model, route, error summary (one line), retry-count chip, cost estimate per request
Expandable inspector shows: payload key-value preview (up to 12 keys), highlighted changed keys vs last-successful, inline KV cache hit/miss hint, and a linked log anchor
One-click 'Re-run in sandbox' opens a safe modal with masked PII fields and the ability to toggle full payload view (requires security review toggle); action logs an audit entry
Design has keyboard navigation, focus states, and meets AA contrast for badges and chips
review_notes: 2026-03-11 - Arjun Patel (Eng): prefetched KV diff for expanded inspector could increase read cost; request telemetry schema change to include a precomputed diff flag (ENG dependency).
2026-03-12 - Priya Shah (PM): prioritize showing 'retryable' badge and estimated cost; hide raw payload by default for privacy compliance. Create PM acceptance for audit log entries.
2026-03-12 - Security review (Simon Lo): sandbox re-run must obfuscate keys marked as sensitive by KMS classification; flagged for a security checklist before release.
decisions: Default card state will be collapsed with a single-line payload summary; full payload requires explicit expand
Show cost estimate calculated from token count and model profile in the collapsed view (rounded to cents), with hover to show breakdown
Implement 'precomputed-diff' flag in telemetry as an ENG dependency to avoid on-the-fly diffs in UI
Rerun-in-sandbox will be gated by a permission level (Console: Debugger > Re-run) and will write an audit log entry
